01 — The Approach

Your broker— in person, not on hold

Insurance has a trust problem — too many scripts, too much fine print. I got into this work to do it the other way: sit down with real people, learn what keeps them up at night, and match them with coverage that fits their life and their budget.

i.

Protection first. Recommendations start with your risks — never with a sales quota.

ii.

Plain English. If you can't explain your policy back to me, I haven't done my job.

iii.

Here after the sale. Question at claim time? You call me — not a 1-800 maze.

02 — Coverage

For life's what-ifs.

As a licensed Aflac agent, I help individuals and families fill the gaps major medical leaves behind — so an accident or diagnosis never becomes a financial crisis.

01 Accident Cash benefits paid directly to you when the unexpected sends you to the ER. 02 Critical Illness A financial cushion for serious diagnoses, so you can focus on getting better — not on bills. 03 Hospital & Disability Income protection and hospital-stay coverage that keeps the lights on while you recover. 04 Life & Final Expense Straightforward plans that protect the people who depend on you.

Supplemental products through Aflac · Availability varies by plan

03 — For Business

On-site, not on hold

Benefits that help you keep good people.
